work_handoff.title: BLACK_LADY_GENERIC_GUEST_CROWD_CORE_SET_V001｜BACK Candidate 01
requirements: This Bundle spec does not by itself authorize Work image generation. BACK Candidate 01 generation requires separate Product Owner authorization.
These are not ten new people. They are the same Guest A-J identities already approved in FRONT, LEFT_PROFILE and REAR_3Q, now viewed from a full BACK orientation.

FRONT is the primary global identity authority. REAR_3Q is secondary rear-geometry continuity authority. LEFT_PROFILE is tertiary side-geometry continuity authority. If references conflict on identity-defining global traits, FRONT WINS.
Target canvas = 1536x1024 landscape / 2 rows x 5 columns.
Fixed slots: top row Guest A/B/C/D/E; bottom row Guest F/G/H/I/J.
Guest A-F are female; Guest G-J are male.
BACK means a full back view approximately 180 degrees from FRONT.
Continue naturally from the approved REAR_3Q toward BACK by approximately another 45 degrees.
The first-glance read must be BACK, not REAR_3Q, not true side profile, and not over-the-shoulder portrait.
Heads and torsos remain naturally aligned away from camera; do not turn heads back to reveal faces.
Preserve identity, apparent age, hairstyle identity, body build, relative height, wardrobe identity, footwear and identity-defining markings from FRONT.
Use REAR_3Q to support rear-side silhouette, shoulder/back geometry, hair fall and rear garment continuity.
Use LEFT_PROFILE only as tertiary support for side hair volume, garment thickness and body proportions.

Guest I must resolve global identity from FRONT: male, clearly muscular, black sleeveless top, short stiff/brush-cut hairstyle and identity-defining tattoo/body-marking family where naturally visible from the back.
Do not propagate LEFT_PROFILE or REAR_3Q accepted tattoo-rendering variations as new tattoo designs.
Preserve ten-person identity separation; do not solve BACK with one repeated back-head/back-body template.
Background must remain simple, neutral and low-distraction. This is a controlled identity reference board, not a Story Shot.
No model-generated letters, names or text labels.
No backpack, shoulder bag, crossbody bag, handbag, luggage, suspicious bag straps, handheld props or story-scene objects.
Generate exactly one BACK PNG only after separate Product Owner generation authorization, then stop for review.
Do not generate Candidate 02, N21 or N23 Candidate 02 in this pass.
exclusions: backpacks or bags of any kind
